model: Liebert Mini-Mate2 1-5 ton and 8 ton (IntelliSlot Unity card)
applies_to: Liebert Mini-Mate2 1-ton to 5-ton and 8-ton units read through a Liebert IntelliSlot Unity card.
summary: The Liebert Mini-Mate2 1-5 ton and 8 ton map is a short legacy list: unit status, temperature and humidity readings and setpoints, an on/off control word and alarm words where several alarms share one object as bits. Only use it with the card variant named in the title.
notes: Tables 5.62, 5.63, 5.64, pdf pages 1602-1605 of the 2024 guide (printed page numbers are 4 lower).
Object names are Vertiv data IDs (e.g. 5331_1); the description holds the guide's data label. Labels repeated for different sensors or circuits get the group name in brackets.
The guide prints the same instance twice for: AV 22 (bc25_1 and bc25_1_deg_F); only the first is listed.
For AV 5, AV 9 and AV 11 the guide prints a second name ending _deg_F in the same row (°F reading); only the first name is listed.

source.title: Liebert IntelliSlot Modbus/BACnet Reference Guide (Modbus RTU and TCP, BACnet MSTP and IP)

integration.summary: Fit a Liebert IntelliSlot BACnet card (IS-UNITY-DP for BACnet IP or MS/TP), give it a unique device instance and let it discover the unit; the objects are then created automatically. Map the on/off and setpoint objects if the BMS controls the unit, and the status, main measurements and event objects for monitoring.

minimum_points.name: bc01_1
minimum_points.why: Control word: unit on/off and lockouts (bit-coded)

setup: The card needs a unique Device Instance Number; the device object represents the card, not the unit.
The cards have no BBMD; IS-UNITY-DP and IS-IPBML support foreign device registration (BBMD address and time-to-live).
IS-UNITY-DP adds BACnet MS/TP; IS-WEBADPT and IS-IPBML are BACnet IP only. Check the compatibility table (guide section 1.1.3) for the card your unit supports.
gotchas: Vertiv asks for no more than about two writes and two reads per second on average; do not rewrite setpoints continuously.
No segmented responses: large ReadPropertyMultiple requests can fail, so split them.
Only data the managed unit actually has is created on the card, so object counts vary by model and options.
